error: Netlify "Page not found" when refreshing or opening a direct link
meaning: Your React/Vite single-page app works when you click around, but reloading /dashboard or opening a shared link shows Netlify's 'Page not found'. Netlify looks for a real file at that path, and only index.html exists.
causes: No SPA fallback rule, so Netlify does not know to serve index.html for app routes.
_redirects was put in the project root instead of the folder that gets published (public/ for Vite).
netlify.toml points publish at the wrong folder.

steps.text: Create public/_redirects (Vite copies public/ into dist/) with one line.
Or add the rule to netlify.toml.
steps.code:
[build]
  command = "npm run build"
  publish = "dist"

[[redirects]]
  from = "/*"
  to = "/index.html"
  status = 200

steps.text: Redeploy and check the deploy summary says '1 redirect rule processed'.
Next.js on Netlify does not need this; use the Next.js runtime instead.

prompt: My Vite React app on Netlify shows 'Page not found' when I refresh any route except /. Add a public/_redirects file containing '/*    /index.html   200' and a netlify.toml with build command npm run build, publish dist, and the same SPA redirect. Don't change the router.

faq.a: The Vite dev server already falls back to index.html; Netlify's static hosting does not.

faq.q: Will this break my API or images?
faq.a: No. Netlify serves real files first; the rule only applies when no file matches.
